Kforce has a client in Jacksonville, FL that is seeking an experienced AI Engineer to evaluate emerging AI technologies, develop rapid prototypes, and help drive adoption of intelligent solutions across the organization. This individual will partner with technical and business teams to identify opportunities, design scalable solutions, and bring AI-driven initiatives from concept through production.

Key Responsibilities:
 
  AI Engineer will stay current with emerging AI technologies, tools, frameworks, and industry trends to inform solution design and technology recommendations 
  Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business challenges and develop AI-powered solutions that improve automation, insights, and operational efficiency 
  Build and prototype applications that leverage modern AI capabilities and integrate with existing systems, platforms, and data sources 
  Provide guidance on AI architecture, implementation strategies, and technology selection while balancing performance, scalability, security, and cost considerations 
  Lead projects through the full development lifecycle, including discovery, design, testing, deployment, monitoring, and optimization 
  As an AI Engineer, you will support both software engineering and data-focused initiatives as business priorities evolve 
  Promote best practices, reusable frameworks, and knowledge sharing to accelerate AI adoption across teams 
  Effectively manage multiple initiatives while serving as a technical advisor, engineer, problem solver, and collaborator in a fast-paced environment 
 
 
  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; Advanced degree preferred 
  3+ years of software development experience, including building AI-enabled applications or automation solutions 
  Experience creating proof-of-concept solutions and evaluating emerging AI technologies for business use 
  Strong application development skills with experience integrating AI capabilities into existing systems and workflows 
  Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, source control, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development practices 
  Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams 
  Passion for continuous learning and staying current with advancements in AI and software engineering 
  Ability to troubleshoot complex technical challenges and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment 

 
Preferred Qualifications:
 
  Experience working within regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, or healthcare 
  Experience with cloud-native architectures and modern deployment practices 
  Background developing AI-powered applications, automation tools, or internal business platforms 
  Familiarity with generative AI, conversational AI, workflow automation, and intelligent assistant technologies 
  Exposure to building reusable frameworks, shared services, or enterprise technology platforms
